Your privacy

Privacy

The action planner works in your browser. This public version has no accounts, advertising trackers, payments or form submissions.

Information you enter

Text entered in the action planner is used only on the current page to create your checklist. It is not submitted to Franklin Navigator, saved to an account or sent to an external AI service.

Basic website delivery

Like most websites, the hosting and security infrastructure may process basic request information such as IP address, browser type, requested page and timing to deliver and protect the site.

External links

When you open an agency, organization or business website, that third party may collect information under its own privacy terms. Review the destination before sharing sensitive information.

Sensitive information

Do not place medical, legal, financial, account, identity or emergency details into the planner. Contact the responsible professional, agency or emergency service directly.

Franklin Navigator
Independent local guidance for Franklin, Tennessee and relevant Williamson County resources.
Linked agencies, organizations and businesses are not affiliated with or endorsed by Franklin Navigator unless expressly stated. Confirm time-sensitive details on the linked source.
